from solution import find_Max_Len_Even


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example: find_Max_Len_Even("python language") == "language"."""
    # len("python")=6 even, len("language")=8 even; 8>6 => "language"
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("python language") == "language"


def test_issue_single_even_word():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word returns the word itself when only one even word."""
    # len("code")=4 even => "code"
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("code") == "code"


def test_issue_tie_returns_first():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word returns the first on a tie."""
    # len("ab")=2 even, len("cd")=2 even; 2==2 => first "ab"
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("ab cd") == "ab"


def test_issue_longest_even_wins():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word returns the longest even word."""
    # len("abcd")=4 even, len("efghij")=6 even; 6>4 => "efghij"
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("abcd efghij") == "efghij"


def test_issue_longer_odd_ignored():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word ignores odd-length words even if longer."""
    # len("abcdefghi")=9 odd ignored, len("lm")=2 even => "lm"
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("abcdefghi lm") == "lm"


def test_issue_boundary_odd_three_vs_even_four():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word picks length 4 over length 3."""
    # len("abc")=3 odd ignored, len("defg")=4 even => "defg"
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("abc defg") == "defg"


def test_issue_first_max_among_equals_later():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word returns first among equal maxima."""
    # len("ab")=2 even, len("cdef")=4 even, len("ghij")=4 even; max 4 first => "cdef"
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("ab cdef ghij") == "cdef"


def test_issue_single_odd_word_not_returned():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word must not return an odd-length word."""
    # len("abc")=3 odd => no even word, so result must not equal "abc"
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("abc") != "abc"


def test_issue_empty_input_no_crash():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word handles empty input without crashing."""
    # input "" has 0 words; just check the call completes
    find_Max_Len_Even("")
    assert True


def test_contract_returns_word_from_input():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word returns a word from the input."""
    # len("to")=2 even, len("be")=2 even, len("or")=2 even; result "to" is in ["to", "be", "or"]
    assert find_Max_Len_Even("to be or") in ["to", "be", "or"]


def test_contract_returns_string_type():
    """Rule: find the first maximum length of even word returns a string for input with an even word."""
    # len("hi")=2 even => expected type str for value "hi"
    assert isinstance(find_Max_Len_Even("hi"), str)
